name: tib-bench-vl
description: A vision–language benchmark that evaluates models' capability to understand and reason about images paired with textual queries (likely focused on Tibetan or low-resource language scenarios). It measures multimodal comprehension, including visual question answering and image-text alignment in a multilingual/low-resource context. The dataset emphasizes real-world multimodal grounding and language-specific challenges.
reputation: Relatively low-profile dataset on Hugging Face, primarily used by researchers working on low-resource vision-language tasks.
